Detailed with an archival buckle in a nod to our heritage, this clog is crafted in a mix of velvety soft suede and our Signature jacquard. The easy slip-on-and-go style is finished with a comfortable molded footbed and a rubber outsole for added traction. Our Signature Jacquard is made with a blend of 46% recycled polyester and 54% regenerative cotton sourced from farms that use regenerative agricultural practices—those that help to maintain and rejuvenate land, increase biological diversity and soil health, and could lead to increased carbon absorption. It reflects our ongoing commitment to helping reduce our impact on the planet.

specifications.Material: Polished pebble leather and smooth leather

descriptionHtml:
Pre-owned and now (re)loved, this Nolita Wristlet 24 is a very special Coach custom design inspired by our commitment to rethinking and reducing our impact on the planet. Saved from the landfill, this gently-worn bag was lovingly repaired and transformed by our in-house craftspeople who added clever details to give it a second life. It’s completely one-of-a-kind, and comes with its own unique set of charms. Wear it, love it, pass it on. Reimagined by Rose Oliva with tonal hand-laced whipstitching for a distinctive touch, this zip-top style has been expertly cleaned, conditioned and restored. Our talented craftspeople Fernando Gutierrez and Yngrid Pichardo Baez embellished the piping with sleek whipstitching, attached a whipstitched short strap with dogleashes and anchors, repaired edgestain, then added a playful repurposed charm. Named for the hip downtown New York neighborhood, the Nolita Wristlet 24 features a convertible chain strap that allows you to carry it as a clutch or top handle. An ideal grab-and-go style, it's crafted of polished pebble leather embellished with floral rivets.

material: Rubber lining, coated Signature jacquard canvas footbed

specifications.Material: Rubber lining, coated Signature jacquard canvas footbed

descriptionHtml:
A modern take on playful Y2K styles, our Jelly sandal is designed with an elevated kitten heel. Featuring a Signature jacquard canvas footbed and a rubber outsole for added traction, the classic thong silhouette is finished with our tonal sculpted C for a heritage touch. Our Signature Jacquard Canvas is crafted of cotton sourced from farms that use regenerative agricultural practices—those that help to maintain and rejuvenate land, increase biological diversity and soil health, and could lead to increased carbon absorption. It reflects our ongoing commitment to helping reduce our impact on the planet.

  • Upper Material: Rubber lining, coated Signature jacquard canvas footbed
  • Lining: Fabric / Polyester
  • Heel / Sole: Heel Height: 0.25"

The shell and webbing of this bag is crafted of 100% recycled polyamide (better known as nylon). It also has 100% recycled polyester lining. It’s all part of our commitment to rethinking and reducing our impact on the planet by repurposing waste materials.

A feel-good find, it’s your chance to get one of our most-loved styles if you missed out the first time. Wear it, love it, pass it on. Our Hall is made for doing it all (just like you).
